Subfigures

Left

standard_coverage <- read.csv("C:/Projects/ForecastEvaluation/Data/standard-scoring/standard_coverage.csv")
standard_coverage <- standard_coverage |>
    select(location, target_end_date, horizon, reference_date,
        model_id, target, coverage_95, prediction_category) |>
    mutate(horizon = horizon + 1)

temp3a <- standard_wis %>%
    left_join(standard_coverage, by = join_by(location, target_end_date,
        horizon, reference_date, model_id, target))

table(is.na(temp3a$prediction_category))
## 
## FALSE 
## 84056
plot_df <- temp3a %>%
    group_by(model_id, prediction_category) %>%
    summarise(mean_wis = mean(wis, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    group_by(model_id) %>%
    mutate(total_wis = sum(mean_wis)) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(model_id = fct_reorder(model_id, total_wis))

plot_df$prediction_category <- factor(plot_df$prediction_category,
    levels = c("over", "on-target", "under"))
figure3a = ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = model_id, y = mean_wis, fill = prediction_category)) +
    geom_col() + coord_flip() + labs(x = "Model", y = "Mean WIS",
    fill = "Prediction Category") + theme_bw()
figure3a

Top right

temp3b = standard_coverage |>
    group_by(model_id, horizon) |>
    summarise(mean_coverage = mean(coverage_95, na.rm = TRUE),
        .groups = "drop") %>%
    group_by(model_id) %>%
    ungroup()
figure3b = ggplot(temp3b) + geom_tile(aes(y = model_id, x = horizon,
    fill = mean_coverage)) + scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "magma") +
    theme_bw() + labs(x = "Horizon (1-4)", y = "Model", fill = "Mean Coverage (95%)")
figure3b

Bottom right

temp3c = rbind(standard_wis |>
    group_by(target_end_date, model_id) |>
    summarize(mean_wis = mean(wis, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop"),
    standard_wis |>
        group_by(target_end_date) |>
        summarize(model_id = "AVERAGE", mean_wis = mean(wis,
            na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop"))

temp3c$target_end_date = as.Date(temp3c$target_end_date)
figure3c = ggplot() + geom_line(data = subset(temp3c, model_id !=
    "AVERAGE"), aes(target_end_date, mean_wis, color = model_id)) +
    geom_line(data = subset(temp3c, model_id == "AVERAGE"), aes(target_end_date,
        mean_wis), color = "black", linewidth = 1) + theme_bw() +
    labs(y = "Mean WIS", x = "Date", color = "Model") + scale_x_date(date_breaks = "1 month",
    date_labels = "%b %Y")

figure3c
